listing.name: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) / Soleanna (sonic06-recomp) (DrummingBird1)
listing.summary: Soleanna (sonic06-recomp): an unofficial PC port of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006), PS3 version, by static recompilation. No game files included: the launcher builds it from your own disc.

original_game_review.reason: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 is a different game from the 1991 Mega Drive Sonic the Hedgehog that shares its title.
